recipe.title: Vantage Spire
recipe.tagline: A 40-storey passenger relay. Cage 2's counterweight is in the concourse floor.
recipe.themeSummary: A 40-storey passenger relay tower run through Founders' Week on a condemned cable. Cage 2's counterweight sits in the Threshold Concourse floor and every handrail carries lantern current.

rooms.name: Threshold Concourse
rooms.description: Twelve belted riders at the barriers, facing the split-flap board. The handrails spark. The iron block in the floor is Cage 2's counterweight.

rooms.name: Cable Gallery 12
rooms.description: Barrier lamps on tripods fire down the walkway from the far end. Trunk 4's cut end swings across the gallery at head height.

rooms.name: Winch House 40
rooms.description: Osei stands at the brake lever with four trunks turning on the drum behind him. The Anchor site is 6 m to his left, under the tally board.

lore.title: Platform 3 log, Day 4
lore.source: warden's logbook, page torn at the spine
lore.text: 17:30. Headcount Platform 3: 1,100. Rated 400. Radioed Winch House 40 at 17:31 and 17:36, no answer. Held the barrier with two lamps and the rope. Sanjay, if you read this before I do, Priya is at the school gate from 18:00 and I am not.

lore.title: Notice to riders
lore.source: printed card taped to the kiosk glass
lore.text: The departures board shows DELAYED on all lines. This is a fault, reported on forms 112, 118, 121 and 130. Riders in cage belts may unclip at the barrier and wait in the concourse. As of 17:52, 300 riders have not. The kiosk closes at 18:00 as normal. L. Pereira.

lore.title: Inspection tag 4-17
lore.source: brass tag wired to the cut end of Trunk 4
lore.text: TRUNK 4. Diameter 41 mm. Minimum 46 mm. Broken wires per lay: 9. Rated load 60 t. Load with six cages up: 88 t. CONDEMNED. H. Vik, Day 2, 09:15. Below, in blue ink: IN SERVICE THROUGH DAY 7. M. Osei.

lore.title: Tag on the Gallery 12 rail
lore.source: inspection tag wired to the walkway rail
lore.text: Trunks 1, 2, 3, 5. Measured Day 3, 14:00. Diameters 46, 45, 46, 44 mm. Load with six cages up: 88 t on four ropes, 22 t each. Rating 15 t each. Trunk 4 parted at 11:20 in this gallery, 3 m from this rail. STOP THE CAGES. H. Vik.

lore.title: Log, Day 5, 17:40
lore.text: 17:40. Cage 2 counterweight came through the concourse roof, 40 storeys, and landed 8 m from the kiosk. The handrails are live. Mrs Dunne took a shock off the Platform 3 rail and is sitting down. Headcount at the barrier 300, all still clipped in. Radioed Winch House 40 at 17:41. No answer, Sanjay. Keep everyone off the rails.

lore.title: Form 131
lore.source: maintenance request, filled in and never filed
lore.text: Form 131. Location: Winch House 40. Fault: door bolted from inside; drum running with no cages attached. Reported by: L. Pereira, kiosk. Previous forms on this location: none, as the door used to be open. Knocked at 04:10 and 04:25. The drum is louder than the door. Requested action: unbolt the door. Priority: as per forms 112, 118, 121 and 130.

lore.title: Cage belt, size M
lore.text: Cage belt, Vantage Spire issue, size M. In the chest pocket, a Day 5 ticket punched for Cage 2 at 17:45. The clip is closed. The kiosk notice from Pereira said riders may unclip at the barrier; the clip needs two hands, and a rider holding a bag has one.

lore.title: Barrier lamp, Platform 3
lore.source: signal lamp on a bent tripod, lens hot
lore.text: Signal lamp, Platform 3 issue, on its tripod. One flash holds, two flashes board. Ramaswami's log has it flashing hold at 1,100 riders from 17:30 on Day 4 until the battery went. Somebody has since wired it to the handrail current.

lore.title: Marshal's load rig
lore.source: steel load rig, belt rings sheared
lore.text: Cage marshal's load rig, rated 120 kg. The marshal counted riders into the cage and stopped the count at 40. Vik's tag on the Gallery 12 rail puts six cages on four trunks from Day 3, 11:20. The rig's counter reads 61.

lore.title: Brake lever, Winch House 40
lore.source: lever head snapped off the winch brake
lore.text: Winch House 40 brake lever, cast iron, snapped 10 cm above the pivot. Vik measured the four trunks on Day 6 through the gap under the bolted door: 44 mm each, at full speed with nothing on them. She wired a tag to the door handle, STOP THE DRUM, with a line for Osei's countersignature. The line is blank.

attunements.name: Two Flashes
attunements.description: Enemy bolts deal 25% less. Ramaswami's signal lamp, Platform 3 issue: one flash holds, two flashes board.

attunements.name: Trunk 4 Parted
attunements.description: A dash leaves a charged trail that burns what follows. Trunk 4 carried lantern current for 3 s after it parted in Cable Gallery 12.

attunements.name: Tag 4-17
attunements.description: The Anchor plants in half the time. Vik wired inspection tag 4-17 to Trunk 4 in 40 seconds; Osei needed two to countersign it.

attunements.name: Board Clears
attunements.description: Clearing a room grants 4 s of haste. Pereira's split-flap board took 4 s to cycle from DELAYED to a platform number, on the days it did.

bible.premise: Vantage Spire is a 40-storey passenger relay tower: six lift cages on five trunk cables, 9,000 riders a day through Founders' Week.
bible.collapse: Rope inspector Hanne Vik condemned Trunk 4 at 41 mm on Founders' Day 2 and superintendent Marek Osei signed it back into service. It parted on Day 3. On Day 5 at 17:40 Cage 2's counterweight dropped 40 storeys into the Threshold Concourse and shorted the lantern circuits into every handrail in the tower.

people.want: 9,000 riders a day through all seven days of Founders' Week

events.fact: Osei opened all six cages for Founders' Week; 9,400 riders went up the spire before midnight.
Vik measured Trunk 4 at 41 mm against a 46 mm minimum, wired inspection tag 4-17 to it marked CONDEMNED, and Osei countersigned the tag IN SERVICE.
Trunk 4 parted in Cable Gallery 12; Osei ran all six cages on the four remaining trunks.
Ramaswami counted 1,100 riders on Platform 3, rated for 400, and radioed Winch House 40 twice with no answer.
Cage 2's counterweight dropped 40 storeys into the Threshold Concourse and the lantern current shorted into the handrails.
Pereira's split-flap board locked every line on DELAYED; 300 riders in cage belts stayed clipped in at the barriers.
Osei bolted Winch House 40 from inside and kept the four trunks turning with no cage on any of them.

authors.name: Hanne Vik
authors.register: Millimetres, tonnes, dates. One measurement per line. The verdict in capitals at the end, then her initials.
authors.never: writes an adjective without a number beside it

authors.name: Dev Ramaswami
authors.register: Times to the minute, headcounts, radio calls logged as sent and answered. Addresses the relief warden, Sanjay, by name.

authors.name: Lotte Pereira

authors.register: Printed notices, form numbers, 'as previously requested'. Counts how many times she has asked. Signs L. Pereira.

laws.name: Rated for 400
laws.description: Ramaswami counted 1,100 riders on Platform 3, which is rated for 400. More enemies per room, each weaker.

laws.name: Clipped to the Rail
laws.description: A cage belt clips to the rail and takes two hands to undo. Operatives barely move during a basic attack and hit harder.

laws.name: Open Shaft
laws.description: Cage 2's shaft is 40 storeys of updraught with no cage in it since Day 5. Dashes carry farther and take longer to come back.
